title: Effect of Prophylactic Treatment on Postoperative Complications
abstract: Background: Complications following major surgery remain prevalent. Methods: In this parallel-group trial, patients received either prophylactic therapy or standard care. Results: The primary clinical outcome was observed in 42 of 500 patients in the intervention group versus 52 of 500 in the control group (rate ratio, 0.82; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.71 to 0.95; P = 0.008). Conclusions: Prophylactic therapy significantly reduced complications.
